Description: ClickHouse cluster on Amazon EKS (Altinity operator, ClickHouse Keeper, EBS gp3, EKS Pod Identity), optional new VPC.

Label.default: Compute (one ClickHouse / Keeper pod per node, Guaranteed QoS)

ClusterName.Description: ClickHouse cluster name (ClickHouseInstallation and remote_servers cluster name; lowercase letters/digits, 2-15 characters). Cannot be changed after creation.

ClickHouseVersion.Description: clickhouse/clickhouse-server and clickhouse/clickhouse-keeper image tag. Changing it performs a rolling upgrade.

ReplicaCount.Description: Replicas per shard (replica N runs in the N-th subnet / AZ).

KeeperCount.Description: ClickHouse Keeper nodes: 3 (HA quorum, one per AZ) or 1 (dev/test).

KubernetesVersion.Description: EKS Kubernetes version (control plane and node groups; upgrade one minor version at a time).

EksPublicEndpoint.Description: Also expose the EKS API endpoint publicly (restricted to EksPublicAccessCidrs). The private endpoint is always on.

EksPublicAccessCidrs.Description: CIDRs allowed to reach the public EKS API endpoint (required with EksPublicEndpoint=true; no default).

EksAdminRoleArn.Description: Optional IAM role ARN granted cluster-admin through an EKS access entry (the stack creator always is).

ClickHouseInstanceType.Description: Instance type of the ClickHouse server node groups (one ClickHouse pod per node).

KeeperInstanceType.Description: Instance type of the Keeper node groups (one Keeper pod per node).

SystemInstanceType.Description: Instance type of the 2 system nodes (operator, CoreDNS, controllers, backup/ops jobs).

ClickHouseCpu.Description: CPU of each ClickHouse pod (requests = limits, Guaranteed QoS). auto = node allocatable minus 800m for DaemonSets.

ClickHouseMemory.Description: Memory of each ClickHouse pod (requests = limits). auto = node allocatable minus 2Gi.

KeeperCpu.Description: CPU of each Keeper pod (requests = limits). auto = node allocatable minus 800m.

KeeperMemory.Description: Memory of each Keeper pod (requests = limits). auto = node allocatable minus 2Gi.

DataVolumeSize.Description: Size (GiB) of each ClickHouse data volume (gp3 PVC, expandable online).

DataVolumeIops.Description: gp3 IOPS of each data volume (changed online via a VolumeAttributesClass).

DataVolumeThroughput.Description: gp3 throughput (MiB/s) of each data volume.

KeeperDataVolumeSize.Description: Size (GiB) of each Keeper volume (Raft log + snapshots).

NodeRootVolumeSize.Description: Root volume (GiB) of every EKS node (OS, images, logs; no ClickHouse data).

CreateVpc.Description: true: create a new 3-AZ VPC (public + private subnets, NAT, S3 endpoint). false: use VpcId / SubnetIds.

VpcCidr.Description: CreateVpc=true: CIDR (/16) of the new VPC.

NatGateways.Description: CreateVpc=true: one NAT gateway per AZ (HA) or a single one (cheaper).

VpcId.Description: CreateVpc=false: existing VPC (DNS hostnames and support enabled).

SubnetIds.Description: CreateVpc=false: private subnets with NAT egress, one per AZ, at least 2 (EKS) and max(ReplicaCount, KeeperCount) with MultiAZ. Replica N / keeper N use the N-th subnet.

MultiAZ.Description: Spread replicas and Keeper nodes across the subnets (AZs); false puts them all in the first subnet.

ClientCidr.Description: Required: CIDR of ClickHouse clients (8123/9000, internal NLB and pod IPs).

ClientLoadBalancer.Description: Internal Network Load Balancer for clients (AWS Load Balancer Controller, IP targets, cross-zone).

EnableBackup.Description: Daily ClickHouse BACKUP of each shard to a new S3 bucket (full on Sundays, incremental otherwise).

BackupRetentionDays.Description: Backups expire after this many days (restorable window: this minus 7 days).

Monitoring.Description: CloudWatch: Container Insights (metrics + logs) and ClickHouse health metrics with alarms and a dashboard. Prometheus: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus with an agentless managed scraper, alert rules, optional Amazon Managed Grafana.

AlarmEmail.Description: Optional e-mail subscribed to the alarm SNS topic.

DiskUsageAlarmPercent.Description: Alarm when a data volume is fuller than this percentage.

LogRetentionDays.Description: Retention of the stack log group /clickhouse/<stack> (installer logs).

CreateGrafanaWorkspace.Description: Prometheus mode: also create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace.

GrafanaAuthProvider.Description: Grafana sign-in. SAML (default) works in any account; AWS_SSO only if IAM Identity Center is enabled for the account/organization.

Assertions.AssertDescription: EksPublicEndpoint=true requires EksPublicAccessCidrs (the CIDRs allowed to reach the public EKS API).

Description.Fn::Sub: Password of the ClickHouse "default" user of stack ${AWS::StackName}
Password of the clickhouse_operator user (Altinity operator) of stack ${AWS::StackName}
Envelope encryption of Kubernetes secrets of EKS cluster ${AWS::StackName}

Fn::Sub:
alertmanager_config: |
  route:
    receiver: sns
    group_by: ['alertname', 'node']
    group_wait: 30s
    group_interval: 5m
    repeat_interval: 4h
  receivers:
    - name: sns
      sns_configs:
        - topic_arn: ${TopicArn}
          send_resolved: true
          sigv4:
            region: ${AWS::Region}
          subject: '[ClickHouse ${AWS::StackName}] {{ .Status }} {{ .CommonLabels.alertname }}'

Properties.Data:
groups:
  - name: clickhouse-backup
    rules:
      - alert: ClickHouseBackupStale
        expr: time() - max by (node) (clickhouse_backup_last_success_timestamp_seconds) > 26 * 3600
        for: 10m
        labels: { severity: warning }
        annotations: { summary: 'No successful backup on {{ $labels.node }} for more than 26 hours.' }
Properties.Name: clickhouse-backup-alerts

Source.BuildSpec:
version: 0.2
phases:
  build:
    commands:
      - mkdir -p /tmp/installer && cd /tmp/installer
      - python3 -c "import base64,gzip,json; [open(k,'w').write(v) for k,v in json.loads(gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))).items()]"
      - bash /tmp/installer/install.sh
  post_build:
    commands:
      - '[ -f /tmp/responded ] || bash /tmp/installer/install.sh report-failure'
